newsitem.title: USA: Greenfield sees Q4 shr about $0.32 to $0.34.
newsitem.headline: Greenfield sees Q4 shr about $0.32 to $0.34.

text.p: Greenfield Industries Inc said on Tuesday it expects to report fourth quarter diluted earnings per share of $0.32 to $0.34 and sales between $124 million and $126 million -- results below company expectations.
The net income range is expected to be $5.2 million to $5.7 million, Greenfield said.
The company added that it anticipates results for the quarter will be reported in early February 1997.

Greenfield president and chief executive officer Paul Jones said in a statement, "While we expect to report sales which are approximately 20 percent over the fourth quarter of 1995 and three to four percent above the third quarter of 1996, preliminary indications suggest that we had a disappointing quarter."
Sales in its industrial, electronics and consumer products did not meet expectations, but energy and construction, engineered products and marine results were better than expected, Greenfield said.
In last year's fourth quarter, Greenfield reported earnings per share of $0.52 on sales of $104.8 million.

Greenfield said several of its factories were affected by "rationalization programs during the year" as well as the start-up issues at its Solon, Ohio plant. The company said its South Deerfield, Mass., facility, which was acquired in January 1996, experienced poor performance in costs and deliveries in the fourth qyarter.
Strength in the oilfield equipment market is helping sales and operations, Greenfield said.
